provenance.vertical_datum: Tokyo Peil (TP), 2019 project specification; no 2025 conversion

review.method: Reverified all 72 original full-domain result hashes against the previously distributed bundle, both measured source domains and solver hash, calibration, baseline, mass balance, boundary audit and unchanged paired-domain screen for all 36 heights. Exhaustive reporting-window search only; no new solve, interpolation, terrain or threshold changes.
review.independent_checks: Analytic and synthetic shallow-water tests; independent ANUGA 3.3.10 mixed-boundary 900 s baseline and forcing34 probe (actual coastal34.8046036 m, not a matched35 m comparison).
limitations: 20 m mesh; no real-site grid convergence or individual building loss calculation
Fixed10-minute eastern wave, baseline0 and fixedroughness
Only selected 1760x1280m reporting area; inundation may continue outside
Earlier model20m target differed from independent ANUGA by up to0.91m; domain sensitivity is not a real-world depth error bound

search.selection: Maximum area among grid-aligned rectangles containing the entire original window, inside the common domain with the stated buffer. Fixed criteria across every supplied height; post-hoc coverage selection, not independent forecast validation.

calibration.definition: maximum model coastal stage rise above initial baseline at declared wet reference cell

boundary_audit.froude_guard_scope: Flather characteristic boundaries only; transmissive outlet Froude is diagnostic
boundary_audit.transmissive_assumptions: Outgoing-wave extrapolation on wet/dry ground, with no external incoming waves and boundaries sufficiently far from the displayed region; oblique-wave reflection and domain-size sensitivity require independent review.
boundary_audit.sampling: retained RK stage and final state; actual numerical reflective-face depth and initially-wet depth disturbance; source edge screen reported separately; boundary volumes integrate both accepted RK flux stages
